comment: Build-time self-checks for the compiled protection engine (compile_protection.py passes them to aerie_protection_compile). They guard against an empty, truncated or wrongly parsed phishing list. 'listed': hosts the pinned list must cover. Phishing Army publishes amiprotected.it and www.amiprotected.it as harmless filtering test domains; they are always in the list. 'unlisted': large legitimate sites that must never be listed (a list that holds them is broken or hostile).
